name: The End of the World Club
source:
What would you do if the world were ending this year?

Or, more realistically: what if it wasn’t, but pretending it might be felt easier than facing entrance exams, graduation, or the thought of never seeing the person you’ve been secretly pining after for over a year ever again?

It’s April 2012, and Itsuki starts his final year of high school like any other: keeping a low profile and hiding his feelings for his classmate Ren.

But everything changes when Rika, an eccentric transfer student, announces that the world will end that December.
